_comment: Selection-eval fixtures: a natural-language build goal, and which skill(s) the model should pick. `expectAny` passes if the picked set includes AT LEAST ONE (tolerates equivalent choices); `forbid` fails if any of these are picked (the classic wrong-neighbour). Add cases whenever two skills are easy to confuse. Run with scripts/eval-skill-selection.mjs.

cases.goal: let me charge users to enter my whole app
sell a single course to buyers
give each user a rechargeable credit balance to spend on the AI
add sign in with ibl.ai to my app
let org admins manage users, roles and permissions
add a chat with an AI agent to my app
train an agent on my PDF documents so it answers from them
show usage and LLM cost analytics for my organization
create a brand new agent from a template
deploy and publish my app to the web
